summary.text: Greg Kessel is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 39 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as farming.

paragraphs.text: Kessel's career experience includes working as a farmer, according to Ballotpedia.

He won the 2022 Republican primary for North Dakota State Senate District 39 over Andrew Kordonowy and then won the general election over independent Thea Lee, and he assumed office on December 1, 2022.
In 2026 he advanced from the June 9 Republican primary, and Ballotpedia lists no other candidate on the November ballot for the seat.
